name: Zionix
tagline: An elegant, modern sanctuary for daily scripture study, communal prayer, and gospel exploration.
description: Zionix is a full-stack Christian spiritual portal that bridges timeless biblical truths with a modern, serene web experience. Its mission is to nourish believers and seekers with daily spiritual nourishment, scripture study, communal intercession, and gospel clarity.
corePillars: Interactive Community Prayer Wall with Confidentiality Controls
experience: Designed to provide an intuitive, peaceful, distraction-free, and uplifting sanctuary for personal and communal faith.
developer: Crafted with modern web technologies (React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, Node.js).
